title: We accidentally made an AI platform: Jamie Turner
talk_summary: This is a short sponsor-style pitch for Convex, a reactive backend-as-a-service, arguing that its query/mutation dataflow model suits generative-AI apps with concurrent backend chains. It contains no engineering techniques for building or operating AI agents.

takeaways.technique: Reactive dataflow for concurrent backend chains
takeaways.what_they_do: They describe apps where multiple concurrent AI chains (names, features, palettes, icons) run in the background and stream results into the app as each finishes, with the backend tracking dependencies so the UI updates automatically.
takeaways.evidence_quote: all of them kind of flow into the application as they have results
